description: Chereeka Garner is recording an interview at UCF’s John C. Hitt Library for the Night Tales Project. She recalls being a senior at University High School in Orlando on September 11, 2001, when her class gathered to take its senior photograph. After the photo, she waited in the courtyard and then entered a classroom where students were watching television coverage of the attacks. Her history teacher told the class that a plane had hit the World Trade Center, and Garner recalls watching the news coverage for about an hour. She called her father, who told her she could go home, but a long line at the attendance office prevented her from signing out. Garner recalls remaining at school until the end of the day and understanding the magnitude of the events more fully after she got home and found her father there.

entities_and_facets.perspective: First-person recollection by a high school senior who learned about the attacks at school and watched television coverage; she does not describe being at an attack site.
